title: rubus pilosus var. infestus
intro: Rubus pilosus var. infestus, commonly known as Bramble, is a type of thorny shrub that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is known for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which provide various health benefits such as reducing oxidative stress, alleviating symptoms of allergies and digestive issues, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Rubus pilosus var. infestus include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can be used to treat skin conditions, wounds, and infections. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
